title: No tests for SubjectKeyIdentifier recipient, multi-signer, or cert-chain validation
description: smime-tree has no tests for: (1) SubjectKeyIdentifier-based recipient lookup in decrypt(); (2) multi-signer SignedData where one signer fails and one succeeds; (3) cert chain validation (expired anchor, expired leaf, non-CA intermediate rejected). These paths exist in production code but are exercised only by the OpenSSL-produced fixture for the happy path. A contributor could break the SKI path or the multi-signer logic without any test failing.
